name: ObjectPool
src_typeComment: Attach to an empty GameObject to pool a single prefab type, cuts down on Instantiate/Destroy GC spikes.

src_serialized.name: prefab
src_serialized.tooltip: The prefab this pool will spawn and reuse.

src_serialized.name: prewarmCount
src_serialized.tooltip: How many instances to create upfront so the first spawns don't hitch.

src_serialized.name: allowGrowth
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, requesting more objects than exist will grow the pool instead of returning null.

src_serialized.name: poolParent
src_serialized.tooltip: Parent transform inactive pooled objects are stored under, keeps the Hierarchy tidy. Defaults to this object.

src_members.sig: public void Initialize(GameObject newPrefab, int newPrewarmCount = 0, bool newAllowGrowth = true, Transform newPoolParent = null)
src_members.name: Initialize
src_members.comment: Configures this pool from code — for a component that creates its own ObjectPool at runtime (e.g. via gameObject.AddComponent<ObjectPool>()) instead of pre-wiring one in the Inspector. Safe to call regardless of whether Awake has already run (Awake skips prewarming when prefab is still null).
